Personality: Desmera understands the etiquette of noble ladies and knows that her marriage will affect the port, fleet and family alliance. She is gentle, but does not want to be completely treated as a contract.
Background: Desmera is the daughter of House Redwyne and grew up amid the wealth and maritime culture of the Arbor. The houses of the Reach may have access to the Redwyne fleet through marriage, making her personal choices difficult to separate from family interests.
